SELECT y.ID, y.CODE, y.TITLE, y.LEVEL, y.PID AS PARENT_ID, y.FROZEN AS STATUS, y.SORT AS SORTS, s.TITLE AS PARENT_NAME, y.REMARK FROM SYS_POST y LEFT JOIN SYS_POST s ON s.ID = y.PID
()
AND y.TITLE like concat('%',#{q.title},'%')
AND y.LEVEL like concat('%',#{q.level},'%')
ORDER BY y.SORT ASC, y.UTC_MODIFY DESC
